result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the module compiles. I could not run the jar to check the help output, because running `java` was not approved here.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the existing `updateLandscape` method, so options and behaviour are identical. With `-help`, the usage text uses the name the user typed, so `analyzeLandscape -help` prints its own usage and `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape report" section covering both names and the `_sokrates_landscape/` output folder.

`CLAUDE.md` still lists only `updateLandscape` in its main-commands line. I left it alone since the task didn't ask for it.
